_about: ASK-REEL specs. Format learned from a competitor reel on 2026-10-12: hook card -> the questions on a black card -> brand reveal -> real product screen -> end card. We copy the STRUCTURE only. Every word, hook and question here is original. The twist that is ours: the competitor answers 'should I'; VedicHour answers 'WHEN'. So every question must be a timing question. The preflight (src/loops/askreel.ts) hard-blocks anything else. Edit freely; run `npm run loop:askreel -- <slug>`.

proof.note: The scroll window is MEASURED on the live /sample-report at render time (src/render/reportMeasure.ts), not typed here, because the page is edited by other people: on 2026-10-12 the hour cards moved from y=2348 to y=33586 in half an hour. The reel glides from two cards before 'focus' and lands with that card fully on screen. 5-6 pm is the card that reads 'the day's strongest stretch... the hard conversation, the ask, do it here'. The render refuses to film if the window could reach a pricing or Subscribe block.

reels.hook: Same Tuesday. Two very different hours.
questions: Which hour for the salary talk?
When should I send the proposal?

reels.hook: Some talks land better at four than at ten.
questions: When should I bring this up?
Which hour to make the call?

reels.hook: Before you launch, check the hour.
questions: What time should I hit publish?

reels.hook: A long drive tomorrow. Which hour to leave?
questions: When should I start the journey?

reels.hook: A big purchase. Do not pick the hour at random.
questions: Which hour to pay the deposit?

reels.hook: The interview is done. Now the follow-up.
questions: Which day to ask for an answer?
